title: SharpCompress
description: A streaming library for reading and writing compressed archive files in .NET.

data.text: `SharpCompress` is a fully managed streaming compression library for .NET. It supports reading and writing `RAR`, `ZIP`, `TAR`, `GZIP`, `BZIP2`, `XZ`, and `7z` archives without relying on native code.
Use `ArchiveReader` to stream through an archive and extract entries to disk or memory.

data.text: Use `WriterFactory` to create compressed archives in various formats.

terms.definition: Opens an archive stream and returns an IReader for iterating entries.
Creates a compression writer for the specified archive type.
Controls behavior like full path extraction and overwrite during extraction.

data.title: Tip
data.text: SharpCompress streams entries one at a time, making it memory-efficient for very large archives.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: SharpCompress supports RAR, ZIP, TAR, GZIP, 7z, and more
ReaderFactory opens archives for streaming extraction
Fully managed with no native dependencies
data.takeaway: SharpCompress is the go-to library for archive handling in pure .NET applications.
